title: A spinodal wave growing in a Cahn–Hilliard mixture
shows: A 50/50 mixture inside its spinodal (f = c²(1 − c)²/4, so f''(½) = −¼) with a small cosine wave of composition: the wave grows as exp(σt) with σ = M·k²·(−f'' − κ·k²), 9.090 per unit time here.
source: Linear stability of the Cahn–Hilliard equation: J. W. Cahn, Acta Metall. 9 (1961) 795–801.

checks.what: the wave's amplitude at the end
